verdicts.reason: Both break the 'duo' in the same way. The serum bottle is shrunk to a tiny figure stranded bottom-left, and the peach circle is cut off in the bottom-right corner, apart from the product. The logo is centred over a left-aligned headline and subcopy, and the CTA is small, centred under a huge cream jar. A is worse because a big empty band splits the headline from its subcopy, so the text block falls apart. B keeps the headline and subcopy together and its bottle is a little more visible, but it still leaves dead space above and below the jar.
